name: Coinbin
rootCause: Coinbin, a south Korean cryptocurrency exchange, is filing for bankruptcy with losses equivalent to more than $26 million after its debts grew after employees embezzled money.

descriptions.text: Coinbin, a south Korean cryptocurrency exchange, is filing for bankruptcy with losses equivalent to more than $26 million after its debts grew after employees embezzled money.

Coinbin, a South Korean cryptocurrency exchange, suffered an internal theft of private keys by a senior employee in February 2019, resulting in a loss of approximately $26 million and bankruptcy. The incident was not a smart contract exploit, but an administrative drain due to insufficient controls over wallet access. A senior Coinbin employee, formerly the CEO of Youbit, appropriated private keys for multiple cryptocurrency wallets,intentionally losing keys and embezzling assets. The lack of separation between critical administrative duties and unrestricted access enabled the theft, resulting in bankruptcy.
